name: Onii-chan Nanka Daikkirai!
original_name: 兄ちゃんなんか大っ嫌い！
source:
In the morning, it was sudden.When I look at the side, I see a naked brother.
In addition, my brother was attacked by Mahito last night.
However, Mahito has no memory as his older brother says.
So Masato decided to look for the "evidence" of last night in his brother's room.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230315073200/http://meowkansoft.starfree.jp/game/brotherhate.html] official site[/url]]
